service.description: The endpoints, models and feature bindings in effect: the llm-facade conf with the LlmEndpoint, LlmModel and LlmFeatureBinding rows over it (a row's fields replace the conf's by id). Keys are masked. Each entry says where it came from (source: conf, database, or conf and database); a model says whether it can take a call (usable: yes, or why not) and a binding which model it resolves to. problemList names the conf entries and rows that did not read.
One small call to a model (modelId, or the first model of endpointId), recorded as an LlmCall with source test.

Tiny live requests for each capability (tools, parallel-tools, json-schema, streaming, reasoning-replay, prompt-caching), each verdict stored in LlmModelCapability with its evidence. An admin's verdict is kept.
An admin's verdict on a capability of a model (yes, no or partial), which no probe replaces; an empty verdict removes the stored one, so the next probe decides.

Recompute the LlmUsageDaily rows of usageDate, or of today and the days before it, from LlmCall: a day's rows are replaced whole, each day in its own transaction, and a day that fails does not stop the others. The job rollup_LlmUsage runs it every 15 minutes.

parameter.name: days
parameter.description: With no usageDate, the days before today

service.description: Clear the request and response content of the calls older than retentionDays (default the llm-facade content-log retention-days). The job clean_LlmCallContent_daily runs it.

Whether a user (default the current one; another user's needs AgentAdmin) may make more calls in a scope (all, agent, gateway, api): the user's LlmQuota row, else the largest of their groups', else the llm-facade limits, against today's calls (and the month's for a monthly quota).

The request and response JSON of an LlmCall (kept only with content logging, redacted): for the call's own user, or for a user with AgentAudit, whose read is written to AgentAuditLog. Anyone else gets no content (contentShown false, with the reason).

parameter.name: reason
parameter.description: Why an auditor reads it, for the audit log

service.description: For System > LLM > Dashboard: the calls, tokens and cost of today (from LlmCall) and of this month (the rollup of its earlier days and today) over all users, as maps with callCount, errorCount, inputTokens, cachedInputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens, cost and currencyUomId; and the runs submitted today, waiting for input or authorization, and failed today.

For System > LLM > PromptPreview: the frozen prefix an agent's new conversation would get on a surface and prompt variant for a user (agentId, default assist; surface, default the agent's first; variant, default the model's; userId, default the current user), and the tail of a sample page: each section with its characters, calibrated tokens, cap and share of the model's budget, the tools with their schema sizes, the system text, the tail, and the request as the model's protocol would send it with a sample message (requestJson, "copy as sent"). The model is modelId, else the agent's feature or tier. The user's memory is shown only for the viewer's own user. Nothing is stored.

parameter.name: surface
parameter.description: drawer, chat, a2a, mcp, job or tui

parameter.name: samplePath
parameter.description: The page of the sample tail

parameter.name: catalogList
parameter.description: The catalog entries; scores come with the skill index
